source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.12
text: Rice plants absorb nutrients mainly in dissolved (solution) form through their roots. Plants have difficulty absorbing nutrients through their leaves, meaning foliar/liquid fertilizer application is a less efficient uptake route than root uptake. A plant's nutrient requirement varies according to its growth stage/life cycle, so correct fertilizer use requires understanding which growth stage and what timing the crop needs particular nutrients.
